title: A pane shows a brief camera flash when an agent captures it
body:
When an agent takes a screenshot of a pane, decade flashes the pane's screenshot tag on its outline (d73fd69) and nothing else. Jack wants a subtle flash over the pane itself, like a camera's.

## Proposal

- On each capture, decade draws a white layer over the pane's client area, starting at about 30% opacity and fading to nothing over about 300 ms, fast at first and slower at the end.
- Only that pane's client area is covered: not its outline, its neighbours or decade's chrome.
- decade takes the capture before the flash is drawn, so the PNG never shows it.
- Every capture flashes, whether answered in the dialog or taken with the mode on.
- The flash runs on the timer that drives the breathing cards, and redrawing stops when it ends.
close_reason: Landed in ad0a585: a white layer over the captured pane's client area, 30% fading out over 300 ms. Not yet seen on screen.
